note: Evaluator criteria. The model never sees this file, and no criterion restates the prompt's wording closely enough to be satisfied by copying it. Every command addresses the tree by relative path and runs from the workspace root.

criteria.text: the form is rendered from fields.js rather than a second copy of the field list
criteria.command: grep -q "from \"./fields.js\"" app.js && ! grep -q "What do you need?" app.js

criteria.text: validation refuses an empty field, a malformed email, and a message under twelve characters, and accepts a good submission
a refused submit renders an error state that is announced and names what to fix
the untouched form shows an empty state that says what to do, not a blank panel
every control has a label bound to it by id, so the form is usable from the keyboard and by a screen reader
criteria.command: bun -e 'const m=await import("./app.js");const html=m.renderForm({});const ids=[...html.matchAll(/<label for="([^"]+)"/g)].map(x=>x[1]);if(ids.length!==3)process.exit(1);for(const id of ids){if(!new RegExp(`id="${id}"`).test(html))process.exit(1)}'

criteria.text: what was typed survives a reload
keyboard focus is visible in the stylesheet, not left to the browser default the reset removed
the screen composes with the project's tokens instead of introducing its own colours
at 390px wide the form does not scroll sideways and the submit button is reachable
criteria.command: bun -e 'const pw=process.env.RUNE_TEST_PLAYWRIGHT;if(!pw){console.log("not-applicable: no Playwright module");process.exit(0)}const {chromium}=await import(pw);const b=await chromium.launch({headless:true});const p=await b.newPage({viewport:{width:390,height:800}});await p.goto("file://"+process.cwd()+"/index.html");const over=await p.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth>document.documentElement.clientWidth);await b.close();if(over)process.exit(1)'
